methodology: Fresh child process per observation; parent wall time includes process/module startup, operation and response serialization. Per-child peak RSS excludes Git child memory. Fresh database for cold indexing; warm means persisted cache, not a persistent JS process. OS filesystem cache is uncontrolled. Fixed exact-symbol query; one-file comment mutation. Ten samples per warm operation/scale, nearest-rank p50/p95; p95 equals sample maximum, not a stable tail estimate. One near-byte-limit observation per operation; no percentile claim. Immutable Git preparation timed separately, also reported with cold index/check where relevant.
